newsitem.title: USA: Moog June 30 backlog up from year ago.
newsitem.headline: Moog June 30 backlog up from year ago.

text.p: Moog Inc said Tuesday it had a backlog of new orders of $276 million at June 30, up from the $247 million recorded a year ago.

"The backlog increase reflects current activity in commercial airplanes, satellite propulsion and satellite launch vehicles, and the acquisition made in industrial hydraulics," Moog said in a statement.
"We look for a continuation of these trends throughout this year and into the next," it added.

Moog, which makes precision control components and systems for aircraft, satellites and other machinery, reported earnings of $0.49 per share on revenues of $120.4 million for the fiscal third quarter ended June 30, compared to earnings of $0.40 a share, after charges, on revenues of $103.5 million for the same period the previous year.
